fundamental.summary: BWA shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 72 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for BWA; congressional activity is stale (249+ days old), market fear/greed is neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (201.28) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 72 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 201.28, strong dollar), zero fundamental conviction (no insider/institutional buying), overbought stochastic with bearish MACD crossover, and imminent earnings binary risk overwhelm technical strength.
